cohort: 3000 healthy primiparous women with a singleton pregnancy, gestational age 37 to 42 weeks, and no maternal/fetal chronic and/or pregnancy-related conditions
finding: AFL level, analyzed within 30 minutes before oxytocin augmentation, is a good predictor of delivery outcome in nulliparous women with arrested labor.
mod_finding: Low levels of AFL may support the decision to continue a prolonged vaginal labor by augmentation with oxytocin.
